The weighted port throughput calculation succeeded by correctly mapping risk factors to port metrics, achieving a 1.0 verifier reward.
The iteration successfully passed the pytest suite in test_output.py with zero exceptions and a 1.000 mean reward. The solution effectively resolved previous failures, though future implementations should verify the stability of weight distributions across varying port datasets. The run completed in 5m 36s, confirming the logic is robust enough to satisfy the specific constraints of the Weighted-Risk-Assessment task.
